basic_details.job_title: IOCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 272 Trade Apprentice, Technician Apprentice and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (a Government of India Undertaking) has 272 apprentice seats at its Barauni Refinery under Advertisement No. BR/HR/APPR/2026-27/II: 190 for Trade Apprentice (Attendant Operator, Chemical Plant), 38 for Trade Apprentice (Boiler), 21 for Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) and 23 for Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation). Applications are online only, from 6 November 2026 to 6 December 2026, on the NAPS/NATS portals and a Microsoft Form reached through www.iocl.com. Stipend is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act and the Corporation's guidelines.

qualification.details: Code and Trade Qualification Required 101 - Trade Apprentice (Attendant Operator, Chemical Plant), Chemical 3 years B.Sc (Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry) 103 - Trade Apprentice (Boiler), Mechanical 3 years B Sc. (Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry) 105 - Technician Apprentice, Mechanical 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engg. 107 - Technician Apprentice, Instrumentation 3 years Diploma in Instrumentation Engg/ Instrumentation & Electronics/ Instrumentation & Control Engg, / Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering | The qualification must be already passed on the reckoning date, 30.11.2026. Candidates whose result is awaited are not eligible. It must be a regular full-time course from a recognised Board/University/Institute, with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates for the seats reserved for them). Where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be entered in the Microsoft Form, and a certificate from the University/Institute is needed at Document Verification. Only the branch or subjects specified against the trade count; no claim of an equivalent qualification is entertained. Diploma holders under a recognised lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc.) or ITI admitted in the 2nd year of the Diploma course) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed percentage on the aggregate of all semesters. A B.Sc candidate (Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry/Industrial Chemistry) may apply for only one of code 101 or 103. Applying for more than one trade leads to summary rejection.

salary_details.details: The stipend per month is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992 (as amended) and the Corporation's guidelines. Training lasts 12 months for codes 101, 105 and 107 and 24 months for code 103, and may be extended under Rule 7 of the Apprentices Rules 1992. | One pair of safety shoes and a helmet are provided, returnable on completion of training, wherever applicable. No HRA or company accommodation is provided. General leave is 32 days (8 days per quarter), including medical grounds. Casual leave is 12 days per calendar year (pro-rata). Holidays follow the establishment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the apprenticeship. Apprentices are covered under suitable accident insurance and under the Certified Standing Orders applicable to workmen at the establishment.

how_to_apply: Both Step I and Step II must be completed; the application is considered only then. Applications in any mode other than online are rejected.

Hold a valid and active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on the NAPS/NATS portal, with the profile 100% correctly updated. Keep an active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year.
Visit www.iocl.com between 06.11.2026 and 06.12.2026 and go to What's New, then Engagement of Apprentices at Barauni Refinery 2026-27(II).
For codes 101 and 103, register on the NAPS portal https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/, choose Apprenticeship Opportunities, search the IOCL refinery location and trade, and apply.
For codes 105 and 107, register on the NATS portal https://nats.education.gov.in and apply to the IOCL Barauni Refinery advertisement on the dashboard.

Apply with the Barauni Refinery Establishment ID: NATS EBRBEC000003, NAPS E11191000001. Check that profile details and aggregate percentage appear correctly; corrections go through the NAPS/NATS office.
Step II: submit the Apprenticeship Additional Data Form: Barauni Refinery 2026 on Microsoft Forms, once only. Enrolment/registration numbers must match in Step I and Step II.
Use the same e-mail ID and mobile number as on the NAPS/NATS portal; they must stay valid for the entire apprenticeship.
Queries: [email protected], 06243-275258 and 275240. Information on Document Verification calls and results will be on www.iocl.com or by e-mail.
important_instructions: Documents for verification: 10th/Matriculation certificate; CGPA/OGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate if applicable; Principal's certificate of result publication date if the marksheet lacks it, which must also state regular full-time mode and good conduct; SC/ST/Disability/OBC (NCL) certificate with Declaration or EWS Income & Asset Certificate; print of NATS/NAPS registration; Annexure-A affidavit; any other document specified. Candidates must declare ailments or abnormalities in the application. They must also declare any earlier UNFIT finding in a medical examination by a refinery unit or PSU, and any arrest, prosecution, detention, fine or conviction, or debarment by a Public Service Commission. SC/ST/PwBD candidates attending Document Verification get single second class railway fare from the nearest railway station of the mailing address and back, on production of the ticket, if the distance is at least 30 KMs. The Corporation has no obligation to offer employment after apprenticeship, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation of candidature and possible criminal prosecution. Candidature is provisional, and engagement is liable to termination if shortcomings are found later. Canvassing in any form can make a candidate ineligible. The management's decision is final on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and mode of selection. Corrigenda or notices will appear on www.iocl.com only. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the local Court at Begusarai. The notice warns against fraudulent agencies and advises relying only on www.iocl.com and Employment News/Press Notifications.

content_sections.heading: About IOCL
content_sections.text: Indian Oil Corporation Limited is described in the notice as a Government of India Undertaking and a Fortune "Global 500" company. It invites these applications as a Skill Building Initiative for the Nation. The apprentices will be engaged at its Barauni Refinery Unit under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 (as amended).

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice gives 272 seats in total. The seat numbers are tentative and may increase or decrease in the relevant categories at the absolute discretion of the management, in compliance with the Presidential Directives on reservation at the time of engagement. UR: Un-reserved; EWS: Economically Weaker Section; SC: Scheduled Caste; ST: Scheduled Tribe; OBC (NCL): Other Backward Class, Non-Creamy Layer; PwBD: Persons with Benchmark Disability. PwBD reservation is on a horizontal basis against the notified seats in identified trades.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification must be already passed on the reckoning date, 30.11.2026. Candidates whose result is awaited are not eligible. It must be a regular full-time course from a recognised Board/University/Institute, with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates for the seats reserved for them). Where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be entered in the Microsoft Form, and a certificate from the University/Institute is needed at Document Verification. Only the branch or subjects specified against the trade count; no claim of an equivalent qualification is entertained. Diploma holders under a recognised lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc.) or ITI admitted in the 2nd year of the Diploma course) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed percentage on the aggregate of all semesters. A B.Sc candidate (Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry/Industrial Chemistry) may apply for only one of code 101 or 103. Applying for more than one trade leads to summary rejection. The age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 24 years as on 30.11.2026 for General/EWS candidates. The only document accepted as proof of age is the Matriculation (Class X) marksheet or certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education. Candidates with a part-time, correspondence or distance-education qualification. Candidates with a higher professional qualification such as BE/B.Tech, MBA, CA, LLB, MCA or equivalent, or pursuing a higher qualification and completing it on or before joining. A declaration is obtained at engagement. Engineering Graduates, Diploma holders or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of job experience after the qualification. Candidates who completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on 30.11.2026. Candidates whose earlier apprenticeship contract was terminated due to the apprentice's failure to carry out its terms. Candidates who completed an earlier apprenticeship in a different trade are eligible if there is a gap of at least one year from completion. If the earlier contract ended through the employer's failure, no gap is needed. If the candidate ended it because of health or financial hardship, relocation, transportation, career change or language barrier, a gap of at least three months from termination is needed, and women have no waiting period. Preference goes to first-time apprentices. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PwBD and EWS is in the numbers shown in the seat table. PwBD candidates can apply only against codes 105 and 107. Engagement is from these categories: PV (low vision, blind), PH (hard of hearing, deaf), PL (musculoskeletal, dwarfism, acid attack victim, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured), and multiple disabilities combining these. A disability certificate under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 is required. faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice seats are there at IOCL Barauni Refinery?
faq.answer: There are 272 seats: 190 for code 101, 38 for code 103, 21 for code 105 and 23 for code 107. The notice calls the numbers tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 6 December 2026, for both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Form. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Codes 101 and 103 need a 3 years B.Sc with Maths, Physics, Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry. Code 105 needs a 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engg., and code 107 a 3 years Diploma in Instrumentation or the related branches listed. Minimum 50% marks apply (45% for SC/ST/PwBD on reserved seats).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 30.11.2026 for General/EWS candidates. Upper age relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL) and 10 years for PwBD.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register and apply on the NAPS portal (codes 101, 103) or the NATS portal (codes 105, 107) with the Barauni Refinery Establishment ID. Then submit the Microsoft Form reached through www.iocl.com. Both steps are compulsory.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: No. Selection is by percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification. Shortlisted candidates then go through Document Verification and a pre-engagement medical examination.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend per month is as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992 (as amended) and the Corporation's guidelines. No amount is printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. Will IOCL give a job after the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. The Corporation has no obligation to offer employment after apprenticeship, and apprentices cannot claim a right to employment on that ground.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one trade?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for one trade or discipline only. A B.Sc candidate may choose either code 101 or 103, and applications for more than one trade are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. Can PwBD candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but only against codes 105 and 107, which have 5 PwBD seats each. They must hold a disability certificate and fall in the listed categories.
